title: Finite covers kill classes with constant coefficients (Stacks 09ZD (2))
statement: Let $X$ be an affine scheme [def-pc-scheme], $Z\subseteq X$ a closed subscheme (a closed immersion $Z\to X$ [def-weil-closed-immersion]), $M$ a finite abelian group with constant sheaf $\underline M$ [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf] on the small etale sites, $q\ge1$ an integer and $\xi\in H^q(Z_{\Et},\underline M)$ a class of etale cohomology [def-weil-pbc-etale-cohomology]. Then there exists a morphism $X'\to X$ which is finite [def-weil-finite-integral-morphism], surjective [def-weil-surjective-morphism] and of finite presentation [def-sbc-locally-finite-presentation] such that the pullback [def-weil-pbc-cohomology-pullback] of $\xi$ along the projection $X'\times_XZ\to Z$ [def-pc-fibre-product] is zero in $H^q((X'\times_XZ)_{\Et},\underline M)$ (the inverse image of the constant sheaf $\underline M$ on $Z$ being identified with the constant sheaf $\underline M$ on $X'\times_XZ$, [lemma-constructible-pullback-constant]).

source.place: Lemma 09ZD (label lemma-integral-cover-trivial-cohomology), part (2), etale-cohomology.tex line 14467; proof: part (1) (integral surjective X' -> X with H^q(Z', M) = 0 for all closed Z' of X', via Lemma 09ZC lemma-gabber-for-absolutely-algebraically-closed), then write X' as a limit of finite finitely presented X'_i (Limits, Lemma 09YZ, label lemma-integral-limit-finite-and-finite-presentation) and use Lemma 03Q6 (label lemma-directed-colimit-cohomology) to stop at a finite stage.

proof.text: *An integral surjective cover on which every closed subscheme has trivial constant cohomology (Stacks: 'Let $X'\to X$ be the integral surjective morphism we found above', part (1)).* By [lem-weil-pbc-integral-cover-trivial-cohomology] (Stacks 09ZD (1)) applied to the affine scheme $X$ there is an integral surjective morphism $\pi:X'\to X$ such that $H^q(Z'_{\Et},\underline M)=0$ for every closed subscheme $Z'\subseteq X'$, every finite abelian group $M$ and every $q\ge1$.

source.place: Lemma 09ZD (label lemma-integral-cover-trivial-cohomology), line 14467, proof of (2), first sentence; part (1) and its proof, first paragraph

proof.text: *$\xi$ dies on $X'\times_XZ$ (Stacks: 'Certainly, $\xi$ maps to zero in $H^q_{\Et}(X'\times_XZ,\underline M)$').* Let $i:Z\to X$ be the closed immersion and $X'_Z=X'\times_XZ$ [def-pc-fibre-product], with projections $i':X'_Z\to X'$ and $w:X'_Z\to Z$. By [lem-weil-pbc-closed-immersion-base-change] $i'$ is a closed immersion, so $X'_Z$ is a closed subscheme of $X'$ and $H^q((X'_Z)_{\Et},\underline M)=0$ by step 1 ($q\ge1$). The pullback $w^*\xi\in H^q((X'_Z)_{\Et},w^{-1}\underline M)$ [def-weil-pbc-cohomology-pullback] lies in a group isomorphic to this one ($w^{-1}\underline M\cong\underline M$ [lemma-constructible-pullback-constant], and an isomorphism of sheaves induces an isomorphism on $H^q$ [lem-weil-pbc-cohomology-pullback-functorial]), hence $w^*\xi=0$.

source.place: Lemma 09ZD (label lemma-integral-cover-trivial-cohomology), line 14467, proof of (2), second sentence

proof.text:
*$X'$ as a limit of finite finitely presented $X$-schemes (Stacks: 'We may write $X'$ as a limit $X'=\lim X'_i$ of schemes finite and of finite presentation over $X$ ... Limits, Lemma 09YZ').* Write $X=\operatorname{Spec}A$ [def-weil-affine-spectrum]; $X$ is quasi-compact and quasi-separated [lem-weil-pbc-qcqs-over-affine] (applied to $\mathrm{id}_X$). By [lem-weil-pbc-integral-morphism-limit-of-finite] (Stacks 09YZ) applied to the integral $\pi$ there are a directed set $I$ (nonempty), an inverse system $(
u_i:Y_i	o X)_{i\in I}$ of $X$-schemes, each $
u_i$ finite and of finite presentation, with transition morphisms $t_{i'i}:Y_{i'}	o Y_i$ over $X$, and $p_i:X'	o Y_i$ over $X$ making $X'$ the limit. Each $Y_i$ is affine, being finite over the affine $X$ [lem-weil-pbc-finite-morphism-permanence] (b); put $A_i=\Gamma(Y_i,\mathcal O_{Y_i})$, so $Y_i=\operatorname{Spec}A_i$ over $\operatorname{Spec}A$, and since every morphism of affine schemes is $\operatorname{Spec}$ of a unique ring map, functorially [def-weil-affine-spectrum], $t_{i'i}=\operatorname{Spec}(\alpha_{ii'})$ for a directed system $(A_i,\alpha_{ii'})$ of $A$-algebras. Let $A_\infty=\varinjlim_iA_i$ [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit]. By [lem-weil-pbc-spec-colimit-limit] $\operatorname{Spec}A_\infty$ with the maps induced by the coprojections is a limit of the same system $(Y_i)$; two limits of one diagram are isomorphic by a unique isomorphism compatible with the projections, so there is an isomorphism $X'\cong\operatorname{Spec}A_\infty$ under which $p_i$ becomes $\operatorname{Spec}$ of the coprojection $A_i	o A_\infty$; it is an isomorphism over $X$ since $\pi=
u_i\circ p_i$.

source.place: Lemma 09ZD (label lemma-integral-cover-trivial-cohomology), line 14467, proof of (2), third sentence; limits.tex Lemma 09YZ (label lemma-integral-limit-finite-and-finite-presentation, line 1697), which Stacks says is 'easy to do in our current affine case'

proof.text: *The base change to $Z$ as a directed colimit of rings.* $i:Z\to X$ is a closed immersion into the affine $X=\operatorname{Spec}A$, hence affine and induced by a surjective ring map $A\to B$: $Z=\operatorname{Spec}B$ [def-weil-closed-immersion]. Put $C_i=A_i\otimes_AB$ and $C=A_\infty\otimes_AB$. By [lem-weil-pbc-fibre-product-affine-spectra] $Y_i\times_XZ\cong\operatorname{Spec}C_i$ and (with step 3) $X'_Z=X'\times_XZ\cong\operatorname{Spec}C$, the projections to $Z$ becoming $v_i=\operatorname{Spec}(b\mapsto1\otimes b)$, $v=\operatorname{Spec}(b\mapsto1\otimes b)$, and the morphisms $t_{i'i}\times_X\mathrm{id}_Z$, $p_i\times_X\mathrm{id}_Z$ becoming $\operatorname{Spec}$ of $\alpha_{ii'}\otimes\mathrm{id}_B$ and of (coprojection)$\otimes\mathrm{id}_B$ (both sides are characterized by their compositions with the two projections [def-pc-fibre-product]). The $C_i$ with the maps $\alpha_{ii'}\otimes\mathrm{id}_B$ form a directed system of rings, and by [lem-weil-pbc-filtered-colimit-tensor-varying-rings] (constant system of rings $A$, $M_i=A_i$, constant $N_i=B$) the map $\varinjlim_iC_i\to C$ induced by the maps (coprojection)$\otimes\mathrm{id}_B$ is bijective; it is a ring homomorphism (each coprojection $\otimes\,\mathrm{id}_B$ is one, and the ring structure of a directed colimit of rings is computed at a common stage), so $C=\varinjlim_iC_i$ as rings, and $v\circ$ (the morphism $\operatorname{Spec}C\to\operatorname{Spec}C_i$) $=v_i$, $v_i\circ\operatorname{Spec}(\alpha_{ii'}\otimes\mathrm{id}_B)=v_{i'}$.

source.place: Lemma 09ZD (label lemma-integral-cover-trivial-cohomology), line 14467, proof of (2), third and fourth sentences (the limit $X'\times_XZ=\lim X'_i\times_XZ$ implicit in Stacks)

proof.text: *Continuity of cohomology (Stacks: 'By Lemma 03Q6 we see that ...').* Apply the ring case of [lem-weil-pbc-etale-cohomology-limit-of-schemes] (Stacks 09YQ, in this project's DAG the node carrying 03Q6) to the directed system $(C_i)$ with colimit $C$ (step 4), $T=Z$, $G=\underline M$ and the compatible maps $v_i:\operatorname{Spec}C_i\to Z$ with limit $v$: the pullback maps induce an isomorphism $\varinjlim_iH^q(\operatorname{Spec}C_i,v_i^{-1}\underline M)\xrightarrow{\sim}H^q(\operatorname{Spec}C,v^{-1}\underline M)$. Put $\xi_i=v_i^*\xi$. By the composition rule [lem-weil-pbc-cohomology-pullback-functorial] (4) and $v_i\circ\operatorname{Spec}(\alpha_{ii'}\otimes\mathrm{id}_B)=v_{i'}$, the transition map of the system sends $\xi_i$ to $\xi_{i'}$, and the canonical map to $H^q(\operatorname{Spec}C,v^{-1}\underline M)$ sends the class of $\xi_i$ to $v^*\xi$.

source.place: Lemma 09ZD (label lemma-integral-cover-trivial-cohomology), line 14467, proof of (2), fourth sentence; Lemma 03Q6 (label lemma-directed-colimit-cohomology); Theorem 09YQ (label theorem-colimit)

proof.text: *A finite stage kills $\xi$.* Under the isomorphism $\operatorname{Spec}C\cong X'_Z$ of step 4 (over $Z$), $v^*\xi$ corresponds to $w^*\xi$ (composition rule [lem-weil-pbc-cohomology-pullback-functorial] (4); pullback along an isomorphism is bijective, its inverse being the pullback along the inverse), so $v^*\xi=0$ by step 2. Fix $i_0\in I$. The class $\iota_{i_0}(\xi_{i_0})$ of $\xi_{i_0}$ in the colimit maps to $v^*\xi=0$ (step 5) under an injective map, so $\iota_{i_0}(\xi_{i_0})=0$, hence there is $j\ge i_0$ with $\xi_j=(\text{transition})(\xi_{i_0})=0$ [def-weil-directed-colimit-abelian-groups]. Transporting along $Y_j\times_XZ\cong\operatorname{Spec}C_j$ (over $Z$) in the same way, the pullback of $\xi$ along the projection $Y_j\times_XZ\to Z$ is zero.

source.place: Lemma 09ZD (label lemma-integral-cover-trivial-cohomology), line 14467, proof of (2), fourth sentence ('for some $i$ large enough')

proof.text:
*The cover $Y_j	o X$.* $
u_j:Y_j	o X$ is finite and of finite presentation (step 3). It is surjective: $\pi=
u_j\circ p_j$ is surjective (step 1), so every point of $X$ is the image under $
u_j$ of the image under $p_j$ of a point of $X'$ [def-weil-surjective-morphism]. With step 6, $X'':=Y_j	o X$ is a finite surjective morphism of finite presentation such that $\xi$ pulls back to zero on $X''	imes_XZ$, which proves the lemma.
